name: Crissy Field to Golden Gate Bridge
blurb: Walk the bayfront at Crissy Field, then cross the Golden Gate Bridge with the red towers and open Pacific wind all around you.

name: Cliffs of Moher Coastal Walk
blurb: Follow the clifftop path above the Atlantic as the sheer Cliffs of Moher drop hundreds of metres to the sea.

name: Stanley Park Seawall
blurb: Follow the seawall around Stanley Park with the North Shore mountains across the harbour, passing beaches and the rock where Siwash lies.

name: Diamond Head Summit
blurb: Climb the old volcanic crater trail through tunnels and stairs to the summit, where Waikiki's curving bay and the Pacific spread out below.

name: Bondi to Coogee Coastal Walk
blurb: The famous coastal walk along sandstone cliffs and rock pools from Bondi Beach to Coogee, with the Pacific crashing beside you.

name: Hallstatt Lakeside
blurb: Stroll the lakeshore of Hallstatt, where the Alps mirror into still green water beside a village of painted houses.

name: Lake Bled Loop
blurb: Circle the emerald Lake Bled on its shore path, with the island church and hilltop castle reflected in the water.

name: Fira to Oia Caldera Path
blurb: Walk the caldera clifftop from Fira to Oia, with the volcanic crater far below and whitewashed villages glowing in the sun.

name: Arashiyama Bamboo to Togetsukyo
blurb: Wander through towering bamboo stalks rustling overhead, then cross the Hozu River toward the wooded hills of Arashiyama.

name: Seven Sisters Cliffs
blurb: Rolling chalk downs drop to white cliffs and turquoise sea along the Seven Sisters, with the Cuckmere river winding to the beach.
